newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss DIAX enters alliance with SBC.
newsitem.headline: Swiss DIAX enters alliance with SBC.

text.p: DIAX, the joint telecommunications company formed by Swiss utilities, said it had picked San Antonio-based SBC Communications Inc. as an alliance partner to enter the Swiss telecommunications market as of 1998.

DIAX was formed earlier this year by six Swiss utilities, which plan to use their communications infrastructure to offer telecommunications services for private and business customers in Switzerland once the telecommunications monopoly disappears.
SBC, the parent of Southwestern Bell, will provide DIAX with the expertise to operate in a deregulated environment, DIAX said in a statement.
DIAX said its entry into the market depended on developments in regulations and particularly the allocation of mobile telephone frequencies.
